           PENTHORUM SEDOIDES

         Virginia Stonecrop

        (PENTHORUM)


A remedy for coryza, with rawness and wet feeling in nose. Throat feels
        raw. Chronic disorders of mucous membranes, with irritability. Chronic post-nasal catarrh;
        chronic pharyngitis, mucous membrane purple and relaxed. Posterior nares feel moist and raw;
        nose and ears feel full. Aphonia, hoarseness, relaxed vocal cords. Hypersecretion of mucous
        membranes. Itching of anus and burning in rectum. Trouble in pharyngeal vault and Eustachian
        tube.



Nose.--    Constant wet feeling in nose  ,
        which no amount of blowing will relieve. Discharge thick, pus-like, streaked with blood.   Post-nasal catarrh   of puberty.



Dose.--  Not very active, and better adapted to chronic
        affections; its use should be persisted in for some time. Lower potencies.



Relationship.--  Compare:   Penthororun
        often follows   Pulsat. Sang; Hydr  .
